reviewNotes: Completed 32 original low-typing adverb questions with separate AI editorial review of complete German sentences, all four distractors, answer keys, bilingual feedback, context variation and inherited CEFR claims. Four records deferred: harsch, herb and intim (adjective versus adverb classification) and heim (regional register/B1 scope). Removed harmful inherited gar example from authored material. Contrasted gebührenfrei with gratis, spatial versus temporal hinterher, and deictic hierzulande. Structural validation is not independent human review, CEFR certification, rights clearance or measured transfer. Unpublished draft only.
